 ‘Love Is Blind’s Rob Feeley Speaks Out in New Message After Explosive Season 11 Reunion
 Rebecca Perlmutter • November 9, 2026, 6:25 pm 
 Sara Mally / Netflix 
 What To Know
 At the Love Is Blind Season 11 reunion, Rob Feeley apologized to ex-fiancée Michaella Giorgio for how their relationship ended.
 In a new social media statement, Rob took responsibility for his actions, acknowledging the hurt he caused her.
 Rob said they had spoken privately and moved forward with mutual respect.
 “Now that the reunion has aired and this chapter comes to a close,” Love Is Blind  Season 11 star Rob Feeley shared, “I’ve been reflecting on everything this experience has taught me. I’m truly grateful for the people I’ve met, the memories made, and the personal growth that came with both the incredible moments and the challenges.”
 On November 8, Rob joined the rest of the Boston cast at the Season 11 reunion , where he faced his ex-fiancée, Michaella Giorgio , and apologized for how things went wrong at the end of their relationship . From his friends entering the picture to his Pod Squad get-together crashout, things went sour before the couple could make it to the wedding episode.
 The day after the reunion, Rob shared a new statement on his Instagram . He wrote, “Looking back, there are moments I wish I had handled differently. There were times when I felt overwhelmed and let my emotions get the best of me. While those moments don’t reflect the person I strive to be, I recognize that they happened, and I take responsibility for how I reacted and where I could have communicated better.”
 “Most importantly, I want to acknowledge the hurt I caused Michaella. Regardless of how I was feeling, she deserved to feel heard, respected, and understood. I’m genuinely sorry for the times I fell short and for how I reacted in certain situations. My intentions don’t change the fact that my actions affected her, and I take responsibility for that.”
 Netflix
 According to Rob, he spoke with Michaella privately since filming the season. He revealed, “I’m grateful we’ve been able to move forward with mutual respect. I’ll always have respect for her and the experience we shared.”
 He added, “What viewers saw throughout the season was just a small part of a much bigger experience, and not every conversation or situation can be fully understood from what makes it onto the screen. That said, it doesn’t take away from the impact of my actions or my responsibility for them.”

 In his conclusion, Rob noted, “With the reunion behind us, I’m taking what I’ve learned and moving forward with a better understanding of myself and others. I’m excited to share more about my experience, what life has looked like since filming, and the projects and opportunities I’ve been working on. There’s a lot to look forward to in the coming weeks, and I’m excited to share what’s next. For now, I’m enjoying some quality time with my family, loved ones, and my [dog] daughter Bailey!”
